author: Lisa Balick
title: 'Awesome': Joint women's sports facility set to open for Fire, Thorns - NewsBreak
text:
By Lisa Balick ,
1 days ago
PORTLAND, Ore. (KOIN) — A brand new dual-sport training center is set to open next month.
The Portland Thorns and Portland Fire will share the Kaiser Permanente Performance Center starting in August — with team owners footing the bill.
With a new grass full-size pitch, along with a turf field, the Portland Thorns finally have their own practice space, instead of trying to squeeze in time at Nike or Providence Park.
“You don’t have to worry about any other teams. We can do what we need to do. We can schedule things and optimize it for us. And so just knowing that is awesome,” said Thorns player Sam Hiatt.
The facility sits on 12 acres in Hillsboro, close to Highway 26. The 60,000 square foot training center will include a 17,000 square foot gym, two full-size basketball courts, high-end training rooms and a full kitchen.
Once the performance center opens, the Fire will also move in and no longer have to practice at Portland State University.
“More and more facilities are popping up that are specific to female athletes,” said Michael Whitehead with Raj Sports.
Whitehead added that this facility is an investment in each team’s current and future women’s athletes.
“This is a fully privately financed facility, financed by RAJ Sports for our two teams. And so there was no public assistance,” he said.
